---
title: "How do I find the mean and median, and which is more typical?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I find the mean and median, and which is more typical?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Put the numeric values into c().

2. Run mean() and median().

3. Compare the two and look for extreme values.

## Runnable example

```{r}
x <- c(12,13,14,15,56)
print(mean(x))
print(median(x))
print(sort(x))
```

## Interpret the result

The mean is 22 and the median is 14. The single value 56 raises the mean; that does not prove it is an error.

## Check before applying this to real data

Compare mean and median and examine unusually high or low observations instead of deleting them.
